reason: It's new in Kochi, so there are no Google reviews and nobody in my building or WhatsApp group has used them yet. I'm not handing my whole house to a crew nobody can vouch for. Right now one bedroom wall is bubbling, so I'll get my usual painter to look at the damp first and wait to see how Turbolux's first jobs go.
objection: A finish date on paper means nothing if the crew vanishes halfway, and it doesn't say what I get if they're late or how long the guarantee against bubbling lasts.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three neighbours or people in my WhatsApp group in Kochi who've had a full repaint done by them, finished on the date, with good Google reviews and a written penalty or refund if the crew misses the date.
